paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: live opencode usage statistics as a Settings page
# OpenCode Usage (OCU)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that shows
live opencode usage in the Harness Web UI: sessions, pro

mpts, tokens,
estimated cost, and per-tool reliability, read on demand from the local `opencode` CLI

pts, tokens,
estimated cost, and per-tool reliability, read on demand from the local `opencode` CLI.
## What you get

- **Settings → OpenCode usage** page with range chips (7 / 30 / 90 days, all time), four stat
tiles,

a token breakdown bar, a per-model usage table, and a tool-reliability table.
- **Live data** from

`opencode stats --json --models`: sessions, tokens, cost, and usage per
provider/model. Each range i

s cached for 30 seconds, and the Refresh button forces a fresh
read.
- **No extra service and no sec

rets**: the Harness Host runs the CLI locally; the page fetches
one authenticated JSON endpoint.
- E
nglish and German page copy, host theme tokens (light and dark), and an original icon.
## Scope

This page reports **opencode's own usage only**. Command Code billing or quota data is
deliberately

orts **opencode's own usage only**. Command Code billing or quota data is
deliberately out of scope.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x with the Web UI (desktop app or `dsh web`).
- `opencode` on the Host, with

the local state that `opencode stats` reads. The Host resolves
the binary at `$OPENCODE_BIN`, `/opt/

homebrew/bin/opencode`, `/usr/local/bin/opencode`,
`~/.local/bin/opencode`, `/usr/bin/opencode`, the

bin/opencode`, `/usr/local/bin/opencode`,
`~/.local/bin/opencode`, `/usr/bin/opencode`, then `PATH`.
## Install
The package is a local bundle (`@local/opencode-usage`), not a registry package.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Install the checkout as a profile bundle: in the Harness, ask the agent to *install the bundle
at `/

absolute/path/dsh-opencode-usage-plugin`* — `plugin_manager install_bundle` links the
directory and
enables it. The row id is `opencode-usage`.

Then open **Settings → OpenCode usage**. Because the package is link-installed, edits in the
checkou
t apply without reinstalling; restart the Harness to reload the Host half.
## How it works
### Host half — `index.js`
Registers one authenticated exact-Fetch route through `ctx.connection.fetch`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Runs `opencode stats --json --models` (`--days <n>` or `--all`) and projects the payload into
smal

l display values: sessions, subagents, prompts, steps, token totals, cost, per-model rows
(provider,

model, variant, steps, tokens, cost), tool calls and the top 8 tools by call count.
- Sorts the mod

el rows by steps and keeps the top 10; `modelCount` carries the full count.
- Caches each range for

30 seconds; `fresh=1` bypasses the cache (used by Refresh).
- Returns `{ ok: false, error }` with st

atus 400 for an unknown range and 502 when the CLI
fails or is missing.
The route lives inside the browser-authentication fence, so only the owner's page can read it.
### Client half — `client.js`

Registers a `settings.section` entry ("OpenCode usage") and renders the page with host theme
tokens.

It fetches the route document-relative (`api/opencode.usage`), so the existing browser
cookie authe
nticates the request. Copy comes from locale dictionaries in English and German.
### Layout
| Path | Purpose |

| `index.js` | Host half: the route, CLI invocation, cache, projection |
| `client.js` | Client half

: Settings page, dictionaries, styles |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `opencode-

usage` row |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/de.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `icon.s

vg` | Plugin icon |
| `docs/preview.png` | Screenshot of the rendered page |
## Development

No build step and no dependencies. Check syntax with `node --check index.js client.js`. The
running
Harness picks up client changes through HMR; restart it after changing `index.js`.
## Tech Stack

- JavaScript (ESM), plain browser module, no build step
- DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle (Cordis loa

der, `dsh.client` web module)
- Host: Node.js, authenticated exact-Fetch route, `node:child_process`

- Client: React from the Harness module table, host `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens
- Data: local `ope
ncode` CLI (`opencode stats --json`)
## Domains
| Env  | URL |

| prod | — (local Harness plugin; no hosted endpoint) |
| dev  | — (same checkout, link-installed in
the `desktop` profile) |
## Client

Internal developer tooling by Alexander Abelt (webmanufaktur). It runs inside the local
DeepSeek Har
ness and has no external client.
